items.prompt: A study in spring light: three people sit in a loose circle on chairs and a mat with their eyes closed, two women and a man, and above them the air holds a faint web of luminous threads joining them into one shape; an old man stands by the window watching.

alt.ru: Кабинет в весеннем свете: трое — две женщины и мужчина — сидят кругом с закрытыми глазами, над ними в воздухе слабая паутина светящихся нитей связывает их в одну фигуру; у окна смотрит старик.
alt.en: A study in spring light: two women and a man sit in a loose circle with eyes closed, a faint web of luminous threads above joining them into one shape; an old man watching by the window.
alt.pt: Um escritório na luz da primavera: duas mulheres e um homem sentados em círculo de olhos fechados, uma teia ténue de fios luminosos por cima a uni-los; um velho a observar à janela.
alt.es: Un estudio con luz de primavera: dos mujeres y un hombre sentados en círculo con los ojos cerrados, una tenue red de hilos luminosos sobre ellos que los une; un anciano mirando junto a la ventana.
